chapters.title: First Light
chapters.intro: A skiff returns with a single thread of Radiance. The harbor has forgotten how to hold the dawn. Set a light on the water, learn its rhythm, and draw the first new chart.
chapters.completion: The first route survives the rebuilding. One constellation is bright enough to follow home.
hints: Rechart when you are ready; Charts and lifetime earnings remain.

chapters.title: A Shared Horizon
chapters.intro: A lone light can mark a channel. A network can reveal the whole coast. Small skiffs and prism beds still shape the work of the largest observatories.
chapters.completion: The harbor recognizes a pattern: old craft and new instruments belong to the same sky.
hints: Reach 25 Charts to reveal cross-tier links.
Build 25 Skiffs and 25 Nurseries in the same fleet.

chapters.title: The Quiet Watch
chapters.intro: Survey crews learn the coast while you are away. Let their notes accumulate, then choose a constellation to study. The harbor has no need for a sleepless keeper.
chapters.completion: The watch stations can carry a night without you. Their patient records reveal the channels that the darkness hid.
hints: Collect twelve completed Surveys over your visits.
Discover three calibration patterns; accessible completion gives the same result.

chapters.title: Three Ways Through
chapters.intro: Beyond the harbor lie three difficult passages. Each asks a different question: what can a small fleet achieve, which links matter most, and what plan holds while you are gone?
chapters.completion: Three passages are charted. Their answers disagree in useful ways, and your archive has room for each.
hints: Open and complete one dossier from each rule family.
Each dossier costs 100 Survey Notes once and remains replayable.

chapters.title: The Keeper’s Craft
chapters.intro: A restored harbor is a practice, not a perfect machine. Rebuild with what you have learned. You can set a plan or keep each decision in your own hands.
chapters.completion: Your charts describe choices as well as coastlines. Future keepers will know why the lights were placed.
hints: Reach 100 Charts and complete five Recharts in total.
Return to a complete five-tier fleet. Automatic resets remain optional.

chapters.title: A Sea of Stars
chapters.intro: The final restoration is a map of six safe passages, with two examples of each craft. No single solution should own the sea. Finish the survey, and leave the horizon open.
chapters.completion: At dawn, the whole harbor answers. The sea has not become smaller; it has become navigable. Your restoration is complete. Keep charting, revisit a favorite challenge, or let the lights watch over the water until you return.
hints: Complete two distinct dossiers from each family.
Six optional dossiers, extra plan slots and decorations can remain unpurchased.

ending.title: The Harbor Remembers
ending.text: At dawn, the whole harbor answers. The sea has not become smaller; it has become navigable. Your restoration is complete. Keep charting, revisit a favorite challenge, or let the lights watch over the water until you return.

balance_hypothesis.note: Counts exclude unlock timing and time spent learning. Actual completion needs native simulations and human cohort evidence; targets are not measured results.
